facts.activity_file: assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of ZV-7211

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on ZV-7211 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in authorising hot work, specifically assessing and permitting hot work adjacent to live plant. ZV-7211 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 23 April 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on ZV-7211 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during start-up after maintenance; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
